name: Notes on Doctrinal and Spiritual Subjects
name_pt: Notas sobre Assuntos Doutrinais e Espirituais
author: Fr. Frederick William Faber
desc: Faber's posthumous notes (1866), selected from his papers by the Oratorians and edited by J. E. Bowden: outlines and drafts of sermons and lectures in seven parts on God and the Holy Trinity, the Sacred Humanity of Jesus, Our Lady and the Saints, the Faith (the Church, the Sacraments, controversy), the spiritual life, miscellaneous subjects and the last things.
desc_pt: As notas póstumas de Faber (1866), escolhidas de seus papéis pelos oratorianos e editadas por J. E. Bowden: esboços e rascunhos de sermões e conferências em sete partes, sobre Deus e a Santíssima Trindade, a Sagrada Humanidade de Jesus, Nossa Senhora e os Santos, a Fé (a Igreja, os Sacramentos, a controvérsia), a vida espiritual, assuntos diversos e as últimas coisas.
editor: J. E. Bowden, ed. (London: Burns, Lambert and Oates, 1866, two volumes)
edition: Notes on Doctrinal and Spiritual Subjects, vols. 1-2 (London: Burns, Lambert and Oates, 1866), University of Toronto scans a580662901fabeuoft and a580662902fabeuoft, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The two volumes are given as seven parts with their sections; the editor's preface is kept, the tables of contents, the dedication, the indexes and the publisher's advertisements are dropped.
